name: Ligtnin's sweep's wait another
what: the sweep's waits by kind (three bytes at BN4 0x080DF7F4, in the unit's blocks) holding 20 frames for kind 2, Ligtnin's, where BN4's holds 10: the bolt on the cube ten frames late

name: Ligtnin's obstacle mask none
what: the sweep's copy's word of panel flags for kind 2 (0x03800000 at BN4 0x080DF9AC, what holds an obstacle) made 0: no panel answers, no bolt on the cube

name: the bolt's type another
what: the bolt's spawner's copy (its movs r0,#0x8e at BN4 0x080DF10C, BN4's own number on the chips' page) naming 0xCB, a type no unit moved: no bolt
